name: Luigelo Davila
headline: Full-stack engineer shipping web, mobile and cloud products from architecture to production.
summary: I've spent 5 years taking software from architecture to production across web, mobile, backend and cloud.

At **Zoloo** (formerly Boloo), a SaaS platform for bol.com sellers with €2.5B+ in member sales and 20,000+ orders a day, I own the native iOS app and lead the migration of core business domains from a monolith to microservices, including moving 40M+ historical records while the system stayed in production.
Before that I led a customer-facing microservices portal at **Applus+**, and I built and launched **Syncflow**, an AI goal planner, as a solo founder.
